profile_projection.exact_rule: - Before edits, inspect owner, tests, and minimum consumer.
- Stop unless behavior/owner/reuse/non-proximity placement/edit scope are proved.
- Before implementation, define normal/invalid/boundary/forbidden outcomes and validation signal; unverifiable work stops.
- Bugfixes require proved cause, similar-path scan, and feasible recurrence proof; symptoms or hypotheses block edits.
- Put rules in their owner or necessary structure only after reuse fails.
- Stop on unresolved placement or dependency direction.

required_terms: Never widen public APIs only for tests
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Never widen public APIs only for tests.
- Make the smallest complete change; exclude unrelated refactors, duplicate helpers, needless dependencies, and untargeted contracts.
- Choose one batch method: test-first/test-after/existing-proof-only/non-test-validation.
- Test-first is required for high risk, reproducible bugs, or review findings.
- Red means absent target behavior, never environment/fixture/import/syntax/unrelated failure.
- Preserve oracle, assertion strength, and derived risk.
- Test-after is only for low-risk local work or primary coverage.
- Existing-proof-only requires covered behavior, a regression mechanism, and fresh post-edit rerun.
- Non-test-validation is only for docs/comments/format/generated sync/static config/schema/build.
- Source/test/fixture/schema/config/generated artifact/validation-command edits stale evidence.
- Rerun after latest material edit as current task-agent evidence; record latest-material-edit/validation-passed.
- Report skipped/flaky/retried/partial/unavailable/not-run.
- Lint/types/build/coverage/manual/full-suite alone never prove changed behavior.

required_terms: older review cannot cover new edits
profile_projection.exact_rule: - After repair: fresh validation, latest actual diff, fresh re-review; invalidate only affected evidence; covering re-review closes, and older review cannot cover new edits.

- Initial Review completes the complete fixed Review Boundary, changed scope, base dimensions, and professional-risk dimensions. Re-review checks only inherited finding resolution, repair diff correctness, repair regression, affected transitive dependents, and the frozen Acceptance/Invariant/Contract/professional-risk boundary.

- Re-review findings are inherited/repair-regression/frozen-boundary-violation/protected-invalidation/adjacent; protected-invalidation→Main→Delta Analysis, while adjacent is residual-only and never Repair.

required_terms: frequency comes only from Review/Risk Boundary and material delay risk
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Level sets depth; frequency comes only from Review/Risk Boundary and material delay risk, never Task completion or categories, and same-or-stronger independent review subsumes only with Review Skills/Specialist obligations covered.
- Reuse fresh/scope-correct/trustworthy-oracle validation; rerun only if stale/gapped/suspicious/flaky/environment-sensitive, concretely doubtful, or independent reproduction is required.

profile_projection.exact_rule: - Only material current-task findings affecting acceptance/correctness/invariant/regression/security/reliability/material code health require repair; adjacent/optional/style/speculative/unrelated/future work does not. Fundamental failure may fail-fast blocked with Reviewed/Unreviewed Scope. Every non-fundamental Initial Review outcome, including findings, requires the complete fixed Review Boundary; a focused Re-review outcome requires its five checks and frozen professional-risk validity without reopening Initial scope. PASS additionally requires no blocking findings.
